product.title: Napa and Sonoma Wine Country Tour

description.text: Full-day coach tour from San Francisco to Napa Valley and Sonoma Valley with scheduled winery visits. The route crosses the Golden Gate Bridge and includes tasting stops plus time in Sonoma Plaza before returning to San Francisco.

highlights: Round-trip wine country day trip from San Francisco
Visits in both Napa Valley and Sonoma Valley

start.description: Departure from selected San Francisco pickup points.

faqs.answer: The listed duration is about 8 to 9 hours.

faqs.answer: The departure point is at selected San Francisco pickup locations.
